name: Checkin
query:
WITH RECURSIVE dates(datein) AS (
            SELECT %(date_from)s AS datein
            UNION ALL
            SELECT DATE_ADD(datein, INTERVAL 1 DAY) 
            FROM dates 
            WHERE datein < %(date_to)s
        )
        SELECT 
            DATE_FORMAT(dates.datein, '%%d') AS Date,
            emp.employee_name AS "Employee Name",
            emp.custom_office AS "Office",
            emp.custom_category AS "Category",
            emp.custom_employment_status AS "Employment Status",
            emp.status AS "Status", 
            (SELECT TIME_FORMAT(TIME(time), '%%h:%%i %%p')
                FROM `tabEmployee Checkin`
                WHERE log_type = 'IN'
                AND custom_is_break = 0
                AND employee = emp.employee
                AND DATE(time) = dates.datein
                LIMIT 1) AS "Time in",
            (SELECT TIME_FORMAT(TIME(time), '%%h:%%i %%p')
                FROM `tabEmployee Checkin`
                WHERE log_type = 'OUT'
                AND custom_is_break = 1
                AND employee = emp.employee
                AND DATE(time) = dates.datein
                ORDER BY time DESC
                LIMIT 1) AS "Break out",
            (SELECT TIME_FORMAT(TIME(time), '%%h:%%i %%p')
                FROM `tabEmployee Checkin`
                WHERE log_type = 'IN'
                AND custom_is_break = 1
                AND employee = emp.employee
                AND DATE(time) = dates.datein
                LIMIT 1) AS "Break in",
            (SELECT TIME_FORMAT(TIME(time), '%%h:%%i %%p')
                FROM `tabEmployee Checkin`
                WHERE log_type = 'OUT'
                AND custom_is_break = 0
                AND employee = emp.employee
                AND DATE(time) = dates.datein
                ORDER BY time DESC
                LIMIT 1) AS "Time out",
            "" AS Total
        FROM 
            `tabEmployee` AS emp
        CROSS JOIN 
            dates
        ORDER BY 
            emp.employee_name, dates.datein
